ig_caption:
What is MCP? USB-C for AI tools 🔌

MCP = Model Context Protocol.
Before it, every AI app needed custom code for every tool.
Now: a server exposes tools, and any agent that speaks MCP can use them.

Real demo: a tiny helpdesk MCP server I wrote, 3 tools.
1️⃣ agent asks "what can you do?"
2️⃣ server answers with names + descriptions
3️⃣ agent calls get_order(A-7731) → shipped

Write the server once, every MCP agent can use it.

Part 1/5 of MCP & Tools. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
